title: List maximum fanin bounded by total size
statement: Let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, and suppose each $c$ in the list has maximum fanin at most its size. Then the maximum fanin among the list is at most the sum of the sizes of its circuits.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
Every $c$ in $cs$ has maximum fanin at most its size
